question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: CALLOW
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Inexperienced**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The word **"Callow"** refers to someone who is young and lacks experience, maturity, or sophistication. (अनुभवहीन या अपरिपक्व) 
• **Example: **The callow intern made several mistakes on his first day at work. 
• **"Inexperienced"** means someone who lacks practical experience or training in a particular field. (अनुभवहीन) 
• **Example: **Being inexperienced, she found it challenging to handle the project on her own. 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'callow'** is **'inexperienced'**. 
Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Inexperienced**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:
 
• **Sophisticated** (विवेकी): Having a great deal of worldly experience and knowledge of fashion and culture. 
• **Example: **She is a sophisticated woman who enjoys the opera. 
• **Experienced** (अनुभवी): Having knowledge or skill in a particular field, especially a profession or job. 
• **Example: **They are looking for an experienced developer for the lead role. 
• **Mature** (परिपक्व): Having reached an advanced stage of mental or emotional development characteristic of an adult. 
• **Example: **His mature response to the criticism was impressive.
